brief: The micro-SaaS with AI play. How solo founders are reaching $20k MRR with single-feature tools and tight niches — and what to avoid.

slots.author: Nico Reed
slots.headline: The Micro-SaaS AI Playbook
slots.body: Solo founders are hitting $20k MRR with tiny AI tools. Here's the blueprint and the pitfalls to avoid.

slots.author: Nico Reed
slots.title: Pick a Painful Niche
slots.body: Don't build for everyone. The richest micro-SaaS products solve one expensive problem for one specific audience.

slots.author: Nico Reed
slots.title: Ship One Killer Feature
slots.body: Users don't want dashboards. They want outcomes. Build the single AI feature that delivers instant, obvious value.

slots.author: Nico Reed
slots.title: Price for Value, Not Cost
slots.body: If your AI tool saves 10 hours, charge accordingly. $49–$99/mo is the sweet spot for B2B micro-tools.

slots.author: Nico Reed
slots.title: Leverage No-Code AI APIs
slots.body: You don't need a PhD. Glue together GPT-4, Stripe, and a landing page. Launch in days, not months.

slots.author: Nico Reed
slots.title: Avoid Feature Creep Early
slots.body: The fastest way to kill momentum is adding bloat. Say no to 90% of requests until you hit $10k MRR.

slots.author: Nico Reed
slots.title: Distribution Beats Perfection
slots.body: Build in public, post daily, and DM your first 50 users. Product is useless if nobody knows it exists.

slots.author: Nico Reed
slots.headline: Ready to Build Your AI Tool?
slots.body: Drop a comment with your niche idea. Let's discuss how to launch it this weekend.
